title: On phase and norm retrieval by subspaces
summary: This paper studies phase and norm retrieval by subspaces. We first investigate norm retrieval by hyperplanes. We show that if $N$ hyperplanes $\{\varphi_i^\perp\}_{i=1}^N\subset \mathbb{R}^N$ allow norm retrieval and the vectors $\{\varphi_i\}_{i=1}^N$ are linearly independent, then these vectors must be an orthonormal basis for $\mathbb{R}^N$. We then present several new properties of subspaces that allow phase and norm retrieval. In particular, we provide a complete classification of two proper subspaces that perform norm retrieval.
